messages:
jamal: Hey all — putting up PR https://git.internal/redwood/pr/78234. Need runtime + infra + sec eyes before I can schedule merge this afternoon. Can @leo (runtime) and @rachel (infra) take a look? /cc @marta for security

anna: Quick Q — this changes auth header ordering for the prefetch handshake. Is that going to affect existing private deploy customers?

jamal: Good call. Short answer: no functional change for customers using our shim, but edge-case raw VPC clients could see a header reorder. I added an opt-in flag `--preserve-auth-order` for compat. see snippet:
```
cmd: ./deploy-tool validate --preserve-auth-order
config: enable_prefetch_compat: true
```

leo: I can take a look, will run a lightweight perf pass against canary config in ~2h. If runtime side is fine, I can approve. :thumbsup:

rachel: I need the perf artifacts and a note on memory delta (expected). Can you paste CI perf link? Also is there an ops rollout note for kv-prefetch cache invalidation?

jamal: CI perf: https://ci.internal/runs/78234/perf — memory +2% p50 token latency unchanged. Rollout note in PR description under "rollout_plan". I also added a short runbook.

infra-bot: CI status: all checks passed ✅ (unit, integration). Canary perf job queued.

marta: Security checklist: looking for auth header order test + threat model blurb. I see the opt-in flag; add a test that exercises both code paths and include it in the PR. Without the test I can't sign off.

jamal: Will add the test shortly. Small patch incoming to the same branch with unit and e2e checks.

leo: After perf run and the extra test I'll approve. If you want to merge today, can we aim for 18:00 PT? I can be on call for the first 30m post-merge.

anna: Heads-up for product: this touches prefetch; tagging @product as FYI (no UI changes).

rachel: Once perf artifacts are in and infra-bot shows canary green I can give infra-ok. Please post the canary link.

ci-bot: Canary perf job finished: canary-78234 result: PASS (latency stable, mem +2.1%). Artifacts: https://ci.internal/canaries/78234/artifacts

rachel: Reviewed artifacts. Memory delta within expected bounds. infra-approval: :white_check_mark: I'll own the merge window coordination. 18:00 PT works for me.

marta: Test added and review done. Security sign-off: :white_check_mark: (added note about logging strip for auth headers).

jamal: Thanks team. I pushed the extra tests and updated the PR description. Locking merge window 18:00 PT. I'll ping here again 10m before.

leo: Got it. I'll be online.

anna: Thanks — noted in sprint board. :rocket:
